say:1:1631404101:1.text: Alright, everyone, quiet! Today we discuss something BIG.
say:1:1631404101:1.source_cn: 大家安静一下，咱们今天要商量大事！

say:2:1631404102:1.text: Big? Coalball... did you find a secret fish treat stockpile?!
say:2:1631404102:1.source_cn: 什么大事啊煤球？是不是发现了新的小鱼干存放地点？！

say:3:1631404103:1.text: Bigger! We're starting an enterprise called <style="highlight">"Mewtual Benefits Inc."</style>, offering services to the humans for profit!
say:3:1631404103:1.source_cn: 比那还重要！我们要开一家<style=highligh...

say:4:1631404104:1.text: Meow... Humans? You mean those enormous beings who open cans? We're... working for them?
say:4:1631404104:1.source_cn: 喵……两脚兽？那些大型生物？我们为他们提供服务？

say:5:1631404105:1.text: Exactly! I've been observing them closely. They adore us, and they're always carrying this thing called "money". By offering them services, we can get them to pay us "money" and use it to fund our dreams!
say:5:1631404105:1.source_cn: 没错！我观察到两脚兽似乎特别喜欢我们，而且他们总是带着...

say:6:1631404106:1.text: Like buying an unlimited supply of canned food? Traveling the world? And... visiting the legendary dried fish factory?! Meow!
say:6:1631404106:1.source_cn: 比如吃不完的罐头？遨游世界？还有……参观传说中的鱼干工...

say:7:1631404107:1.text: Exciting, isn't it? First, we need to figure out what kind of services we can offer.
say:7:1631404107:1.source_cn: 对呀！重点是，我们需要想出能为两脚兽提供哪些服务……

say:8:1631404108:1.text: Hmm... I can do Warm Bed Occupation Services. They seem to like it when I sleep on their feet and refuse to move.
say:8:1631404108:1.source_cn: 唔……我可以提供暖被窝服务，两脚兽似乎喜欢我在他们脚边睡觉！

say:9:1631404109:1.text: Excellent. We'll also offer Emotional Support Cat Services: we sit nearby while they drink strange liquids and allow controlled petting.
say:9:1631404109:1.source_cn: 我们还可以提供猫咪陪伴服务，就是两脚兽喝奇怪液体时，我...

say:10:1631404110:1.text: I... I can give out robes made of my fur as free gifts...
say:10:1631404110:1.source_cn: 我……我可以免费赠送沾满毛球的法袍……

say:11:1631404111:1.text: ... Nope. Absolutely not. That service is banned.

say:12:1631404112:1.text: Meow... I'd do anything for unlimited dried fish!
say:12:1631404112:1.source_cn: 喵呜……不管了，总之，为了小鱼干！

say:14:1631404114:0.text: For our dreams! The Mewtual Benefits Inc. is officially up and running!
say:14:1631404114:0.source_cn: 为了梦想！猫猫服务商会，正式成立！
